There is no song titled “Oldie (Odd Future)” by **Frank Ocean** alone; **“Oldie”** is a track by the hip-hop group **Odd Future** (also known as **Odd Future Wolf Gang** or **OFWGKTA**), and Frank Ocean is one of the featured vocalists on the song, not the primary artist. The track is the closing song on Odd Future’s 2012 album *The OF Tape Vol. 2* [1][3].
